errors.text_span: FEVE (16.1%, light blue), SNLI (15.4%, orange), VITAMINC (13%, light green), MULTINLI (11.3%, red), ANLI (4.6%, yellow), FACTCC (2.6%, green), ENTFA (1.8%, dark green), XSUMHUL (1.6%, gray), SCITAIL (1.2%, brown), PUBHEALTH (0.5%, light brown), MULTIFC (0.5%, dark brown), and SCIFACT (0.1%, dark blue)
errors.evidence: The color descriptions for most of the slices are incorrect. For example: FEVER (16.1%) is teal/cyan, not 'light blue'; VITAMINC (13.0%) is light cyan, not 'light green'; ANLI (4.6%) is orange-red, not 'yellow'; ENTFA (1.8%) is yellow, not 'dark green'; SCITAIL (1.2%) is light green, not 'brown'; XSUMHUL (1.6%) is light blue, not 'gray'; MULTIFC (0.5%) is lavender/light purple, not 'dark brown'.
